name: Nginx Proxy Manager
description: Shows the sites your Nginx Proxy Manager publishes (proxy hosts, redirections, streams, 404 hosts) and ties each to the device or Docker container behind it: a card on that device, the sites a proxy serves, certificate expiry events, optional HTTPS checks per site and optional DNS names for the domains. Read-only, through a user that can only view. Tested on Nginx Proxy Manager 2.15.1 (login and permission checks on a real instance; site data with simulated answers).
author: Netlens
supports: Nginx Proxy Manager 2.15.x (login tested on a real instance)
Sites, certificates and access lists read with simulated data matching the 2.x API

releases.changelog: Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
Adds a dashboard card with the number of sites, switched-off sites, proxy hosts, redirections, streams and 404 hosts. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.

First release. Proxy hosts, redirections, streams and 404 hosts with their certificates, tied to the device or container behind each site; certificate expiry events; optional HTTPS check per site; optional DNS names. Needs Netlens 0.3.116 or newer.
